name: Indigo Ag
short_description: Applies beneficial microbes and carbon programs to farm profitability.
why_relevant: Showed crops can be bred for carbon capture with digital verification.

name: Pivot Bio
short_description: Engineered microbes deliver nitrogen to crops substituting synthetic fertilizer.
why_relevant: Reduces fertilizer emissions with a drop-in seed treatment.

name: Taranis
short_description: AI scouting from high-resolution flights spots pests earlier than scouts.
why_relevant: Leaf-level detail is a step beyond drone imagery into precision treatment.

name: Semios
short_description: Wireless monitoring plus in-canopy insect detection for tree fruit.
why_relevant: Runs always-on insect suppression data for permanent crops.

name: CropX
short_description: In-ground soil sensors plus cloud that automates irrigation decisions.
why_relevant: Sensible wireless sensor network adopted across many countries.

name: Sentera
short_description: Converts drone and satellite imagery into agronomic recommendations.
why_relevant: Cheap multispectral payloads that democratize field intelligence.

name: FarmWise
short_description: Robots with vision pull weeds without chemicals by the lane.
why_relevant: Reduces herbicide use on specialty crops with robot labor.

name: Verdant Robotics
short_description: Turns tractors into precision robots for spray and thinning of orchards.
why_relevant: Cut chemical inputs in half with per-plant treatment data.

name: Naio Technologies
short_description: Small, electric robots that weed vegetables without fossil fuel.
why_relevant: European leader in inter-row weeding robotics for organic farms.

name: Aigen
short_description: Solar-powered AI robots weed rows without batteries or pesticides.
why_relevant: Demonstrates completely unplugged, emission-free fieldwork.

name: Carbon Robotics
short_description: Autonomous LaserWeeder burns weeds at 5,300 weeds per minute.
why_relevant: Kills weeds chemically-free and logs every treatment for the grower.

name: Blue River Technology
short_description: See & Spray uses vision to spot-spray weeds instead of whole fields.
why_relevant: Sold into John Deere to cut herbicide volume across row crops.

name: Beyond Meat
short_description: Producer of plant-based burgers and sausages distributed worldwide.
why_relevant: Put plant-based protein into mainstream global retail.

name: Impossible Foods
short_description: Recreates meat taste with plant heme, now across thousands of restaurants.
why_relevant: Fermentation-made heme delivers the beefy flavor of real meat.

name: Meati Foods
short_description: Grows whole-cut mushroom-root fillets from fungal mycelium.
why_relevant: Grows the whole 'steak' not a blend, and it reads as fibrous.

name: Nature's Fynd
short_description: Grows protein from a Yellowstone hot-spring microbe in a vertical farm.
why_relevant: Protein from air-fed fermentation without land or weather risk.

name: NotCo
short_description: Uses AI to match dairy and meat flavors with plant ingredients.
why_relevant: Latin America's flagship AI-first food CPG company.

name: Upside Foods
short_description: Produces chicken and beef from cultured animal cells without slaughter.
why_relevant: One of the first two cultivated-meat approvals in the United States.

name: Eat Just
short_description: Maker of JUST Egg and a global leader in cultivated meat (Good Meat).
why_relevant: First company to sell cultivated chicken commercially (Singapore).

name: Mosa Meat
short_description: Pioneers cultivated beef built from real cow cells, aiming for price parity.
why_relevant: The original cultivated-burger spin-out from Maastricht University.

name: Aleph Farms
short_description: Grows steaks from non-modified cow cells without antibiotics.
why_relevant: Grants in Singapore and collaborations to scale cultivated steaks.

name: Brightseed
short_description: Maps plant phytochemicals with AI to unlock health compounds.
why_relevant: Turns the plant kingdom into a searchable library of healing molecules.

name: Fermata
short_description: Detects pests and disease on virtual trapping from grower photos.
why_relevant: Replaces sticky traps with proactive smartphone diagnostics.

name: AgroScout
short_description: Drone and satellite imagery that detect crop disease automatically.
why_relevant: Early blight detection before the human eye can see it.

name: Plenty
short_description: Indoor vertical farms producing leafy greens at warehouse scale.
why_relevant: Vertical farming at True-Scale with Walmart distribution deals.

name: 80 Acres Farms
short_description: Runs fully automated indoor farms that grow greens in 20 days.
why_relevant: Automation-first indoor farming profitable off the national grid.

name: Ohalo
short_description: Improves potato and berry genetics with accelerated breeding tech.
why_relevant: Cut potato breeding cycles from years to a single growing season.

name: Pairwise
short_description: Gene-edits everyday crops for better flavor using CRISPR.
why_relevant: Launching the first improved-taste gene-edited salad and berry varieties.

name: Tropic Biosciences
short_description: Builds disease-resistant bananas and coffee with gene editing.
why_relevant: Runs the banana edit pipeline fighting Panama disease for smallholders.

name: Sound Agriculture
short_description: Biologicals that prompt plants to fix their own nitrogen.
why_relevant: Switches half of on-farm nitrogen feed back into the biological loop.

name: AgBiome
short_description: Scans microbes to find friendly strains that replace chemical pesticides.
why_relevant: Connected microbiome discovery converted into real agro products.

name: Locus Agricultural Solutions
short_description: Applies root-hub microbes that supercharge nitrogen and yield.
why_relevant: Microbial root hubs shown to improve yield and carbon across crops.
